host: research-8xpro6000 (VM .106), 8x RTX PRO 6000, aggregated TP8/EP8, DSPARK block 3, 1M ctx
method: same image + same env; only DSV41_SM120_MXFP8 / DSV41_SM120_MXFP8_MIN_M differ; 32 reqs per level, 256 output tokens, temperature 0
critical_finding: an install-order bug made the MXFP8 wrapper snapshot the RAW Triton kernel as its fallback, silently disabling the tuned SM120 config table on every declined (decode) call. Fixed by resolving the fallback at call time. Before the fix C1 fell 194->123 tok/s; after the fix it is neutral.
verdict: MIN_M=512 (prefill-only) is neutral-to-positive (C1 +1.2%, C32 +4.0%, prefill TTFT -8%). all-M regresses (C16 -28%, prefill TTFT 9x worse).
correctness: greedy probes 17*23=391 and 144/12=12 correct in every arm
caveats: prefill TTFT is affected by prefix-cache warmth and varied between restarts; treat as indicative
single restart per arm: restart-to-restart variance in speculative acceptance (0.49-0.71 observed) can move C1 by ~3%
no unsampled/quality evaluation; no long-run stability test
